files.path: uploads/science/2 DNA.docx
files.reason: Requires scientific correction: identifies the DNA base A as adenosine rather than adenine, says every human cell contains nuclear DNA, and gives an inaccurate account of chromosome packaging.

files.path: uploads/science/2011 10 PERIODIC TABLE QUEST.docx
files.reason: Dated periodicity booklet with embedded key: identifies radon as the heaviest noble gas and uses oversimplified orbital/period rules; substantial orbital and ionisation content also extends beyond lower-school scope. Requires correction before inclusion.

files.path: uploads/science/2013 10 DNA & PROTEIN STRUCTURE IN EVOLUTION WORD CLOZE.docx
files.reason: Requires scientific correction: states that each gene codes for the same amino acid in all organisms, confusing genes with codons. Also depends on Pearson Science 10 page 88.

files.path: uploads/science/2013 10 DNA WORKSHEET.docx
files.reason: Incomplete activity: instructions require a fourth sheet containing a DNA strand, but the document has only three pages and no matching strand template.

files.path: uploads/science/2013 10 DOG BREED CHARACTERISTICS.docx
files.reason: Needs revision: presents broad dog-breed aggression and temperament generalisations as fixed biological facts without evidence; unsuitable as a reliable artificial-selection resource in its current form.

files.path: uploads/science/2013 10 EVOLUTION ANSWER KEY.docx
files.reason: Misleading answer-key filename and scientific errors: this is largely notes and uncompleted tasks; misidentifies a horse–zebra hybrid as a zeedonk and claims all ligers are infertile.

files.path: uploads/science/2013 10 FACTORS AFFECTING REACTION RATES PRACTICAL.docx
files.reason: Practical requires correction and teacher revision: describes molarity M as moles rather than moles per litre, gives no standard magnesium strip dimensions for fair comparison, and omits a risk assessment for heating sulfuric acid.

files.path: uploads/science/2013 10 GROUPS OF THE PERIODIC TABLE.docx
files.reason: Requires scientific correction: states neutral hydrogen has a single positive charge, mixes historical and modern group numbering, and overgeneralises transition-metal properties.

files.path: uploads/science/2013 10 MORE GROUPS OF THE PERIODIC TABLE.docx
files.reason: Requires scientific correction: tells students to label every remaining element as a transition metal, misclassifying p-block elements; also states neutral hydrogen has a single positive charge.

files.path: uploads/science/2013 10 NATURAL SELCTION 2.docx
files.reason: Visual review found mouse diagrams split and cropped at page breaks, making the generation-counting task unreliable; repair layout before inclusion.

files.path: uploads/science/2013 10 NATURAL SELECTION LESSON 1.docx
files.reason: Requires scientific correction: labels domestic dogs Canis vulgaris, defines a scientific theory as merely a possible explanation, and contains dated or oversimplified human-evolution statements.

files.path: uploads/science/2013 10 PERIODIC TABLE.docx
files.reason: Outdated image-only periodic table: omits later elements and uses superseded temporary element names. Replace with a current complete reference table.

files.path: uploads/science/2013 10 SIMPLE PERIODIC TABLE.docx
files.reason: Outdated image-only periodic table: incomplete later-element entries. Replace with a current complete reference table.

files.path: uploads/science/2013 Classifying volcanoes.docx
files.reason: Requires scientific correction: presents eruption styles as a fixed least-to-most explosive sequence ending in Pelean eruptions and combines Plinian with Vulcanian descriptions inaccurately.

files.path: uploads/science/2013 Websites Earthquakes Liquefaction.docx
files.reason: Bare list of external video URLs with no worksheet, instructions or substantive teaching content; unsuitable for the worksheet catalogue as supplied.

files.path: uploads/science/2014 Activity - What are Habits.doc
files.reason: Topic could not be identified confidently from document content; held for manual classification.

files.path: uploads/science/2014 DNA Cut colour and paste activity.docx
files.reason: Incomplete cut-and-paste activity: refers to separate A3 and A4 DNA component sheets that are not contained in this two-page document.

files.path: uploads/science/2014 Earthquakes.docx
files.reason: Requires scientific correction: describes a one-unit Richter increase as ten times the force and says earthquake energy is released at the epicentre; confuses magnitude, amplitude, energy and focus.

files.path: uploads/science/2014 Evolution Worksheet Ch 3.1.docx
files.reason: Requires scientific correction: misidentifies a horse–zebra hybrid as a zeedonk, claims all ligers are infertile, and defines evolution only as formation of new species.

files.path: uploads/science/2014 FOOD CHAIN GAME.docx
files.reason: Incomplete game: rules and recording table are supplied, but the required organism card set is missing; the remaining pages are blank.

files.path: uploads/science/2014 Haiti Earthquake 2010.docx
files.reason: Requires scientific correction: describes the epicentre as 10 km deep, confusing epicentre and focus. The reproduced early news report is a historical source, not a current account of casualties.
